source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 1005 guarded top.msgWindow?.statusFeedback because a new profile could have a window object with null feedback. Optional access only to docShell would not protect the listener argument. Selected context-only entry 4857 later removes statusFeedback and the corresponding progress-listener plumbing; bounded accepted aboutMessage checks find neither symbol. The general lesson is to check the optional object required by the action. Do not restore this removed API or present its 2024 guard as current code.
title: Keep the 2024 progress-listener null guard as a historical startup lesson
